name: Program coverage percentile
definition: Where a program's obligation-coverage ratio sits among anonymized peers in the same profile cluster.
blurred_sample: your program ranks in the ▓▓th percentile of ▓▓ peers

name: Notification-clock readiness
definition: Distribution of measured time-to-notify (GDPR 72h / DORA initial report) across the peer cluster, from tabletop exercise evidence.

name: Regulatory churn exposure
definition: How much of the peer cluster's obligation base changed in the last 12 months (from L1 clause-level change events), versus this program's.
